# Fever Dream Comedy

Fever Dream Comedy is a website and backend synchronization service for a comedy brand built with React, Vite, Firebase Hosting, Cloud Functions, and Firestore.

## Primary goals

- Present upcoming shows, comedian profiles, and booking information
- Sync Eventbrite events and related assets into Firestore
- Support SEO-friendly static prerendering for public pages
- Track marketing conversions through a centralized consent-aware analytics layer

## Core documentation

- [`README.md`](README.md) — project overview, setup, deployment, and tracking guidance
- [`docs/tracking.md`](docs/tracking.md) — analytics, GTM, consent, and conversion tracking contract

## Key application areas

- [`src/App.jsx`](src/App.jsx) — application shell and top-level composition
- [`src/AppRoutes.jsx`](src/AppRoutes.jsx) — route definitions
- [`src/pages/`](src/pages) — page-level views such as home, shows, book, services, and comedians
- [`src/components/`](src/components) — shared UI and conversion components
- [`src/lib/`](src/lib) — Firebase, Eventbrite, tracking, SEO, and support utilities
- [`functions/index.js`](functions/index.js) — Cloud Functions for backend synchronization and automation

## Build and deployment

- Frontend build: `npm run build`
- Local development: `npm run dev`
- Hosting target: Firebase Hosting with static files served from `dist`
- Backend target: Firebase Cloud Functions and Firestore

## Notable integrations

- Eventbrite event sync
- Google Tag Manager
- Meta Pixel loaded through GTM
- Firebase Auth, Firestore, Hosting, and Cloud Functions
